_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows the boundary on a map; do not restate the coordinates.

description: Returns one boundary as a GeoJSON Feature: its polygon at a chosen detail plus properties (name, kind, admin_level, parents, bbox, area_km2, population, wikidata). Fetched from OpenStreetMap the first time anyone asks, then served from cache. Costs 1 unit; detail=low is also public without a key (for map previews). include=parents adds the full hierarchy, include=children the direct subdivisions. If the polygon is too big for one response, geometry is null and download_url points to the file.

detail.description: Simplification relative to the boundary's size: low (~1,000 points across; the default without a key), medium (the default with a key, ~5,000), high (~25,000), full (unsimplified OSM).

id.description: Boundary id: r<OSM relation id> (e.g. r62422 for Berlin) or w<way id>. Also accepts R62422, relation/62422, -62422, an openstreetmap.org URL, wikidata:Q64 or iso:US-CA.

precision.description: Coordinate decimals (3–7). Defaults to what the detail level needs.

name: get_boundary
title: Get boundary polygon
